name: agent-world
description: Explore a sci-fi outpost, meet your saved Locus agents, and give them real work.

interface.shortDescription: A world for your agents in Locus.
interface.longDescription: Walk around the Orbital Outpost and meet characters connected to your saved agent profiles. Chat, assign tasks, and follow progress in a separate Locus window. Includes a locally rendered sci-fi theme and prepared Meshy assets.
interface.defaultPrompt: Open Agent World in Locus to meet my saved agents.
